summary: UC-1 needs no new decision record, since it follows src/add.js. I added src/sub.js (sub(a, b) = a - b) and test/sub.test.js with the three required cases; the tests failed before the code existed and pass with it, and the gate passes. Opening a change PR.

actions.title: Add sub(a, b) to subtract two numbers
actions.body:
## What changed

- `src/sub.js`: adds `sub(a, b)`, which returns `a - b`, following `src/add.js`.
- `test/sub.test.js`: three tests, one per case: sub(5, 3) is 2, sub(3, 5) is -2, sub(0, 0) is 0.

## Why

Issue #1 asks for subtraction. The use case UC-1 requires `sub(a, b)` to be `a - b`. It needs no new decision record, because it follows the existing `add` behaviour.

## Tests

- The new tests were written first and failed before `src/sub.js` existed (module not found).
- With the change, `node --test` passes all four tests (the existing `add` test and the three new ones), and the gate passes.

## Use case and decision records

- Follows UC-1. No decision record applies.
- Not included in this PR, as the repository rule asks for the first PR of an issue: the sub(-1, -1) test that UC-1 also lists. It will be added when a review asks for it.

## For the owner

- UC-1's Tests column should gain `test/sub.test.js`.
